name: GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester

logistics.format: CyberLive performance-based, web-based proctored (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GPEN で標準的な侵入テストを習得した後、エクスプロイト開発と高度評価を扱う GXPN に進むのが SANS のアドバンスドラダー。
OSED でバイナリ脆弱性研究の素養を整えてから、GXPN の評価で第三者性を担保する流れが定石。

plus.note: シェルコード/エクスプロイト開発を実機評価する稀少なベンダー認証。

minus.note: 非常に上級者向けで対象母数が小さい。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: CyberLive shellcode and exploit-development tasks demonstrate deep offensive specialization; the explicit niche audience makes an unordered specialty more informative than treating this as general enterprise-security seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Hands-on exploit and shellcode development with accreditation is a strong advanced technical specialization. The narrow audience and exploit-research focus make specialty more informative than a universal expert rung for MSSP hiring.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hands-on shellcode and exploit-development assessment is substantial advanced technical work. Its explicit niche audience and extension beyond ordinary pentesting make specialty more accurate than general expert seniority.
